name: Misha Tor'kren
summary: At the Tor'kren Farm in western Durotar, Misha Tor'kren waits for word of her son. Kron went west toward the Southfury River to hunt crocolisks, but has not returned.

sections.title: A Mother's Vigil
sections.body: Misha Tor'kren tends her farm near Thunder Ridge, southeast of the ridge. Her son Kron went west toward the Southfury River to hunt crocolisks and prove his mettle, but he never came home. With Durotar's frontier dangers stretching the orcish watchtowers thin, Misha has no word of where he is. She needs travelers willing to search the riverbanks for signs of her son.

sections.title: A Grim Token
sections.body: Kron fell to the Southfury River's crocolisks. Misha can receive only his salvaged amulet, a bitter reminder of the dangers young orcs face as they try to prove their strength in Kalimdor's wilderness.

faq.answer: Misha Tor'kren tends the Tor'kren Farm in western Durotar, southeast of Thunder Ridge.

faq.q: Where did her son Kron go?
faq.answer: Kron went west toward the Southfury River to hunt crocolisks and prove himself as a hunter, but he did not return home.

faq.q: What happens when you look for Kron?
faq.answer: Misha asks travelers to search for Kron along the river. His disappearance weighs heavily on her, and she needs someone to investigate.

faq.q: Is she related to Rexxar's bear Misha?
faq.answer: No. Misha is an orc farmer in Durotar, distinct from Rexxar's loyal bear companion, who shares her name.

angles.text: Kron's attempt to prove his strength against Durotar's wildlife shows the cost of youthful pride.
Misha's son met danger from river predators before he had mastered the wild.
